svg.title: Lantern Vale — house upgrade prototypes
svg.desc: Four cottage structural upgrade stages within the existing one-tile footprint. Timber cottage, braced cottage, stone-footed cottage and stone cottage. Timber framing remains a separate purchase rather than a fifth structural level. Proposed artwork only; no gameplay changes.

g.text: LANTERN VALE / HOUSES / STRUCTURAL UPGRADE PATH
A cottage that grows with the village.
Four existing levels. One 1×1 footprint throughout. The same roof family, door scale and warm windows.
a raised roof and a small bench.
walls and a small roof dormer.
Full stone walls and a dormer,
with the same warm roof tones.
Extra cross-bracing marks the existing timber-frame purchase.
It can appear on any house level; it does not replace the four-step structural path.
Keep worker/resident-capacity plaques separate from the house silhouette.
DESIGN REVIEW ONLY · existing upgrade rules retained · no in-game house art changed yet
